mapper.select: SELECT c.CONTACT_NO, c.USER_NO, u.USER_ID, u.USER_NICKNAME, c.CONTACT_TITLE, c.CONTACT_CONTENT, c.CATEGORY, c.STATUS, c.ANSWER_CONTENT, c.ANSWER_AT, c.CREATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN FROM CONTACT_TBL c JOIN USER_TBL u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE NVL(c.DELETE_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND c.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY c.CONTACT_NO DESC

SELECT c.CONTACT_NO, c.USER_NO, u.USER_ID, u.USER_NICKNAME, c.CONTACT_TITLE, c.CONTACT_CONTENT, c.CATEGORY, c.STATUS, c.ANSWER_CONTENT, c.ANSWER_AT, c.CREATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN FROM CONTACT_TBL c JOIN USER_TBL u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE NVL(c.DELETE_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND c.CONTACT_NO = #{contactNo} AND c.USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT c.CONTACT_NO, c.USER_NO, u.USER_ID, u.USER_NICKNAME, c.CONTACT_TITLE, c.CONTACT_CONTENT, c.CATEGORY, c.STATUS, c.ANSWER_CONTENT, c.ANSWER_AT, c.CREATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN FROM CONTACT_TBL c JOIN USER_TBL u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE NVL(c.DELETE_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND c.CONTACT_NO = #{contactNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTACT_TBL ( CONTACT_NO, USER_NO, CONTACT_TITLE, CONTACT_CONTENT, CATEGORY, STATUS, CREATED_AT, DELETE_YN ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTACT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{contactTitle}, #{contactContent}, #{category}, '대기', SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N' )
